profile.name: Nikola Mihaylov
profile.tagline: I build fast, accessible and beautifully animated web experiences.
bio: I am a developer who enjoys turning complex problems into clean, intuitive interfaces. I care about performance, accessibility and the small details that make a product feel polished.
When I am not coding, you will usually find me training, hiking in the mountains or flying my drone to capture views from above.

koleto-portfolio.summary: This site: a personal portfolio with an interactive three.js hero, light/dark themes and smooth scroll animations.
description: A fast, fully responsive single-page portfolio built with React and TypeScript. The hero features an interactive particle sphere rendered with React Three Fiber that assembles on load and scatters away from the cursor, over an ambient canvas of drifting particles.

Styling follows the SCSS 7-1 architecture, with theme colours defined as CSS custom properties so light and dark modes switch instantly. Framer Motion powers scroll reveals, card interactions and page transitions, and all content is served from typed local data, so no backend is needed. Every piece of text is available in English and Bulgarian, switchable from the navigation.

tennis-court-asenovgrad.summary: Court booking platform for a tennis club, with a customer site, an admin panel and a trainer dashboard.
description: A full-stack booking platform for a tennis club in Asenovgrad, Bulgaria. Customers can check availability, book a court as a guest or with Google sign-in, add an optional trainer, and reschedule or cancel up to two hours before the start.

Staff manage everything from an admin panel with bookings, revenue and occupancy stats, court management (surfaces, working hours, pricing, photos) and user roles. Trainers get their own dashboard for sessions, working hours and time off. Double bookings for both courts and trainers are prevented at the database level with exclusion constraints, and transactional emails go out for confirmations and cancellations.

sipspot.summary: Website for a cocktail bar with a filterable menu of 290+ real cocktail recipes, recipe pages, a photo gallery and table reservations.
description: SipSpot is a multi-page site for a fictional cocktail bar, built with React and TypeScript. The menu pulls 290+ real recipes from TheCocktailDB API through TanStack Query and Axios, with caching so drinks that were already loaded aren't fetched again.

Guests can search the menu, filter it by IBA classics, category, base spirit, strength, ingredient and glass, sort it, or let "Surprise me" pick a drink. Each cocktail has its own page with ingredients, measures and a step-by-step method, and tapping an ingredient finds more drinks with it. The site also has a signature drinks section, a testimonial carousel, a gallery with a full-screen photo viewer, an about page and a reservations section, all in a warm, luxury look with Framer Motion animations.

autohub.summary: Full-stack car marketplace for browsing, selling and managing car offers, with user and admin roles.
description: AutoHub is a car marketplace with an Angular front end and a Node.js/Express REST API backed by MongoDB. Visitors can search and filter offers by brand, model or category, sort by price or date, and browse image galleries, with infinite scrolling throughout.

Registered users manage their profile and their own car offers, mark cars as sold, save favourites and view all offers from a dealership. Admins get a central panel to manage users, categories and every offer. Authentication uses JWT with bcrypt-hashed passwords, and the UI combines custom components with Angular Material, animations and toast notifications.

kolplace.summary: Full-stack e-commerce shop with carts, orders, reviews, Econt delivery and an admin panel with statistics.
description: KolPlace is an online shop built as the final project of the SoftUni React course, with a custom design and a REST API built from scratch on Node.js, Express and MongoDB. Visitors can browse, search, sort, filter and paginate products, view product galleries, reviews, similar and promoted products, and find the stores on a map.

Signed-in users manage a cart and favourites, write reviews with ratings, and place orders with delivery through the Econt API, while admins manage products, categories, stores, reviews and users and see sales statistics. Authentication uses JWT with bcrypt, Framer Motion drives the animations, and the site has light and dark themes that follow the browser preference.

solar-system-planets.summary: Interactive guide to the planets of the solar system over an animated three.js starfield.
description: A small React and TypeScript app that presents the eight planets of the solar system over an animated three.js starfield rendered with React Three Fiber. Planet data is fetched from a REST API, with all requests sent in parallel and a loading spinner while they resolve.

Selecting a planet opens a detail view with its image, type, description, year length and number of moons, plus a link to read more on Wikipedia. An optional ambient space soundtrack can be toggled from the corner, and heavier parts of the UI are lazy-loaded.
